# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

"""Compile-only producer-first cluster probe; no GPU kernel execution."""

import argparse
import ast
import copy
import importlib
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import tarfile
import traceback
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from tools import qsa_prefill_pipeline_trace as trace  # noqa: E402

SOURCES = (
    "tools/qsa_prefill_producer_first.py",
    "tools/test_qsa_prefill_producer_first.py",
    "tools/run_qsa_prefill_producer_first.sh",
    "docs/qsa_prefill_producer_first_probe.md",
    "tools/qsa_prefill_pipeline_trace.py",
)


def snapshot(text):
    headers = list(re.finditer(r"^//.*IR Dump (?:Before|After).*$", text, re.M))
    matches = [i for i, h in enumerate(headers) if "Before TritonGPUPipeline " in h[0]]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Requires exactly one pre-pipeline snapshot")
    i = matches[0]
    return (
        text[
            headers[i].end() : (
                headers[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(headers) else len(text)
            )
        ].strip()
        + "\n"
    )


def producer_first(text):
    cluster = r"loop\.cluster = (-?\d+) : i32"
    if set(re.findall(cluster, text)) != {"0", "1"} or set(
        re.findall(r"loop\.stage = (-?\d+) : i32", text)
    ) != {"0", "1"}:
        raise RuntimeError("Requires the original two-stage/two-cluster schedule")
    if len(re.findall(r"\bscf.for\b", text)) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Requires one original score loop")
    result, count = re.subn(
        cluster, lambda m: "loop.cluster = " + str(1 - int(m[1])) + " : i32", text
    )
    if count < 2:
        raise RuntimeError("Incomplete cluster rewrite")
    return result, count


def resume_function(source, namespace):
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    cls = next(
        n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "CUDABackend"
    )
    fn = copy.deepcopy(
        next(
            n
            for n in cls.body
            if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "make_ttgir"
        )
    )
    if [n.arg for n in fn.args.args] != ["mod", "metadata", "opt", "capability"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Unsupported backend method signature")
    branches = [
        (i, n)
        for i, n in enumerate(fn.body)
        if isinstance(n, ast.If) and ast.unparse(n.test) == "capability // 10 in [8, 9]"
    ]
    if len(branches) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Unsupported SM90 pipeline structure")
    index, branch = branches[0]
    calls = [
        n
        for n in branch.body
        if isinstance(n, ast.Expr)
        and isinstance(n.value, ast.Call)
        and ast.unparse(n.value.func) == "passes.ttgpuir.add_pipeline"
    ]
    if (
        len(calls) != 1
        or ast.unparse(calls[0].value)
        != "passes.ttgpuir.add_pipeline(pm, opt.num_stages, dump_enabled)"
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Unsupported pipeline entry")
    fn.name = "_qsa_resume_ttgir"
    fn.decorator_list = []
    fn.body = (
        ast.parse(
            "pm = ir.pass_manager(mod.context)\ndump_enabled = pm.enable_debug()\n"
        ).body
        + copy.deepcopy(calls)
        + fn.body[index + 1 :]
    )
    adapted = ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[fn], type_ignores=[]))
    scope = dict(namespace)
    exec(compile(adapted, "<private-qsa-compiler-tail>", "exec"), scope)
    return scope[fn.name], ast.unparse(adapted) + "\n"


def inspect(ir, ptx):
    lines = ir.splitlines()
    loops = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if re.search(r"\bscf.for\b", line)]
    if len(loops) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Unidentified main loop")
    start = loops[0]
    indent = len(lines[start]) - len(lines[start].lstrip())
    end = next(
        i
        for i in range(start + 1, len(lines))
        if lines[i].startswith(" " * indent + "}")
    )
    body = lines[start + 1 : end]
    dots = [
        i for i, line in enumerate(body) if re.search(r"\bttng.warp_group_dot\b", line)
    ]
    copies = [
        i
        for i, line in enumerate(body)
        if "ttg.async_copy_global_to_local" in line
        and "tensor<64x128x!tt.ptr<bf16>" in line
    ]
    waits = [line.strip() for line in body if "ttng.warp_group_dot_wait" in line]
    slots = 0
    for line in lines:
        m = (
            re.search(r"memdesc<((?:\d+x)+)bf16", line)
            if "ttg.local_alloc" in line
            else None
        )
        if m:
            dims = [int(v) for v in m[1].rstrip("x").split("x")]
            if dims[-2:] == [64, 128]:
                n = 1
                for d in dims[:-2]:
                    n *= d
                slots += n
    if not dots or len(copies) != 1 or not waits:
        raise RuntimeError("Unidentified K-copy/dot/wait schedule")
    clean = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/|//[^\n]*", "", ptx, flags=re.S)
    return dict(
        K_slots=slots,
        early_K_copies=sum(i < dots[0] for i in copies),
        K_copy_line=start + 2 + copies[0],
        first_dot_line=start + 2 + dots[0],
        dot_sites=len(dots),
        waits=waits,
        mma_sites=len(re.findall(r"\bwgmma.mma_async\.", clean)),
        async_copy_sites=len(
            re.findall(r"\bcp.async.(?:ca|cg).shared.global\b", clean)
        ),
    )


def resources(text):
    regs = set(int(v) for v in re.findall(r"Used (\d+) registers", text))
    spill = set(
        (int(a), int(b))
        for a, b in re.findall(
            r"(\d+) bytes spill stores, (\d+) bytes spill loads", text
        )
    )
    if len(regs) != 1 or len(spill) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Unknown/ambiguous PTXAS register or spill resources")
    stores, loads = next(iter(spill))
    return dict(
        registers_per_thread=next(iter(regs)),
        spill_store_bytes=stores,
        spill_load_bytes=loads,
    )


def gate(control, candidate):
    a, b = control["schedule"], candidate["schedule"]
    if candidate["spill_store_bytes"] or candidate["spill_load_bytes"]:
        return "candidate spills"
    if a["mma_sites"] != b["mma_sites"] or a["dot_sites"] != b["dot_sites"]:
        return "matrix work changed"
    if len(a["waits"]) != len(b["waits"]):
        return "WGMMA materialization wait count changed"
    if not b["async_copy_sites"] or not b["early_K_copies"]:
        return "no early hardware-async K copy"
    if b["K_slots"] not in (2, 3):
        return "unexpected K buffer count"
    return None


def prepare(source, report):
    summary = json.loads((source / "pipeline-trace-summary.json").read_text())
    if (
        summary["status"] != "passed"
        or len(summary["jobs"]) != 4
        or summary["gpu_kernel_executed"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Requires successful four-way compile-only trace")
    expected_names = {
        case + "-" + side for case in trace.CASES for side in ("baseline", "candidate")
    }
    if {j["name"] for j in summary["jobs"]} != expected_names or any(
        j["exit_code"]
        or not all(j["coverage"].values())
        or j["result"]["status"] != "passed"
        or j["result"]["actual_ptx_sha256"] != j["result"]["expected_ptx_sha256"]
        for j in summary["jobs"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Incomplete four-way trace identity")
    jobs = []
    for case in trace.CASES:
        old = source / (case + "-baseline")
        spec = json.loads((old / "spec.json").read_text())
        prior = next(j for j in summary["jobs"] if j["name"] == old.name)
        if (
            prior["exit_code"]
            or not all(prior["coverage"].values())
            or prior["result"]["status"] != "passed"
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Unvalidated captured production trace")
        if (
            trace.sha(old / "replayed-ptx.txt") != spec["expected_ptx_sha256"]
            or prior["result"]["actual_ptx_sha256"] != spec["expected_ptx_sha256"]
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Captured PTX identity changed")
        if spec["original_resources"]["constants"]["num_stages"] != 2:
            raise RuntimeError("Requires original production stage2")
        original = snapshot((old / "passes.txt").read_text())
        changed, count = producer_first(original)
        metadata = old / Path(spec["metadata"]).name
        if trace.sha(metadata) != spec["metadata_sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Captured compiler options changed")
        for kind, text in (("control", original), ("producer", changed)):
            folder = report / (case + "-" + kind)
            folder.mkdir()
            # .ttir selects the patched TTGPU resume entry; its content is the
            # already-scheduled GPU IR. No TTIR/early GPU passes are repeated.
            ir = folder / "scheduled.ttir"
            ir.write_text(text)
            meta = folder / "options.json"
            meta.write_bytes(metadata.read_bytes())
            job = dict(
                spec,
                name=folder.name,
                directory=str(folder),
                kind=kind,
                ir=str(ir),
                ir_sha256=trace.sha(ir),
                metadata=str(meta),
                metadata_sha256=trace.sha(meta),
                cluster_changes=count if kind == "producer" else 0,
            )
            trace.save(folder / "spec.json", job)
            jobs.append(job)
    return jobs


def child(options):
    job = json.loads(Path(options.worker_spec).read_text())
    folder = Path(job["directory"])
    os.environ.update(
        MLIR_ENABLE_DUMP="1",
        MLIR_DUMP_PATH=str(folder / "passes.txt"),
        TRITON_ALWAYS_COMPILE="1",
        TRITON_DUMP_PTXAS_LOG="1",
        TRITON_CACHE_DIR=str(folder / "cache"),
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="",
    )
    for name in (
        "TRITON_PTXAS_PATH",
        "TRITON_DISABLE_LINE_INFO",
        "TRITON_OVERRIDE_ARCH",
        "DISABLE_PTXAS_OPT",
        "PTXAS_OPTIONS",
    ):
        value = job["runtime"]["environment"].get(name)
        if value is None:
            os.environ.pop(name, None)
        else:
            os.environ[name] = value
    for name in (
        "TRITON_KERNEL_OVERRIDE",
        "TRITON_KERNEL_DUMP",
        "TRITON_OVERRIDE_DIR",
        "LLVM_IR_ENABLE_DUMP",
    ):
        os.environ.pop(name, None)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(options.flagtree).resolve()))
    import triton
    from triton.backends.compiler import GPUTarget
    from triton.backends.nvidia import compiler as backend

    for name, record in job["runtime"]["compiler_files"].items():
        path = Path(importlib.import_module(name).__file__).resolve()
        if (
            path != Path(record["path"]).resolve()
            or trace.sha(path) != record["sha256"]
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Compiler identity changed: " + name)
    if (
        trace.sha(triton.__file__) != job["runtime"]["triton_init_sha256"]
        or trace.sha(os.environ["TRITON_PTXAS_PATH"])
        != job["runtime"]["ptxas"]["sha256"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Runtime/assembler identity changed")
    if (
        trace.sha(job["ir"]) != job["ir_sha256"]
        or trace.sha(job["metadata"]) != job["metadata_sha256"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Replay input changed")
    resume, code = resume_function(Path(backend.__file__).read_text(), vars(backend))
    (folder / "compiler-tail.txt").write_text(code)
    metadata = json.loads(Path(job["metadata"]).read_text())
    target = metadata["target"]
    if target != dict(backend="cuda", arch=90, warp_size=32):
        raise RuntimeError("Unexpected target")
    before = trace.sha(backend.__file__)
    with patch.object(backend.CUDABackend, "make_ttgir", staticmethod(resume)):
        kernel = triton.compile(
            job["ir"],
            target=GPUTarget(**target),
            options=trace.restore_options(metadata),
        )
    if before != trace.sha(backend.__file__):
        raise RuntimeError("Installed compiler changed")
    for name in ("ptx", "ttgir"):
        (folder / (name + ".txt")).write_text(kernel.asm[name])
    (folder / "kernel.cubin").write_bytes(kernel.asm["cubin"])
    record = dict(
        status="compiled",
        gpu_kernel_executed=False,
        ptx_sha256=trace.sha(folder / "ptx.txt"),
        cubin_sha256=trace.sha(folder / "kernel.cubin"),
        shared_bytes=kernel.metadata.shared,
        schedule=inspect(kernel.asm["ttgir"], kernel.asm["ptx"]),
    )
    if job["kind"] == "control" and record["ptx_sha256"] != job["expected_ptx_sha256"]:
        record["status"] = "control_mismatch"
    trace.save(folder / "result.json", record)
    return 0 if record["status"] == "compiled" else 2


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-report", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--flagtree", default="/opt/flagtree")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=300)
    parser.add_argument("--worker-spec")
    options = parser.parse_args()
    if options.worker_spec:
        return child(options)
    report = Path(options.report_dir).resolve()
    report.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    summary = dict(
        status="preparing", gpu_kernel_executed=False, timings={}, jobs=[], decisions=[]
    )
    trace.save(
        report / "sources.json",
        {
            name: dict(text=(ROOT / name).read_text(), sha256=trace.sha(ROOT / name))
            for name in SOURCES
        },
    )
    try:
        if (
            trace.sha(ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/ops/qsa_select_paged_prefill.py")
            != trace.PRODUCTION
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Production changed")
        jobs = prepare(Path(options.source_report).resolve(), report)
        for job in jobs:
            folder = Path(job["directory"])
            cmd = [
                sys.executable,
                "-I",
                str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
                *sys.argv[1:],
                "--worker-spec",
                str(folder / "spec.json"),
            ]
            code = trace.run_job(
                cmd,
                dict(
                    os.environ,
                    PYTHONNOUSERSITE="1",
                    PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1",
                    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="",
                ),
                folder / "compiler.txt",
                options.timeout,
            )
            result = (
                json.loads((folder / "result.json").read_text())
                if (folder / "result.json").is_file()
                else {}
            )
            summary["jobs"].append(
                dict(name=job["name"], exit_code=code, result=result)
            )
            if code or result.get("status") != "compiled":
                print(
                    "\n".join((folder / "compiler.txt").read_text().splitlines()[-40:]),
                    flush=True,
                )
                raise RuntimeError("Compiler/control failed: " + job["name"])
            result.update(resources((folder / "compiler.txt").read_text()))
            trace.save(folder / "result.json", result)
            print(
                job["name"],
                "early K",
                result["schedule"]["early_K_copies"],
                "K slots",
                result["schedule"]["K_slots"],
                "registers",
                result["registers_per_thread"],
                "shared bytes",
                result["shared_bytes"],
                "spill store/load bytes",
                result["spill_store_bytes"],
                result["spill_load_bytes"],
                flush=True,
            )
            if job["kind"] == "producer":
                control = summary["jobs"][-2]["result"]
                reason = gate(control, result)
                decision = dict(
                    case=job["name"].rsplit("-", 1)[0],
                    status=(
                        "not_promising"
                        if reason
                        else "compile_feasible_pending_accuracy"
                    ),
                    reason=reason,
                    extra_K_slots=result["schedule"]["K_slots"]
                    - control["schedule"]["K_slots"],
                    extra_shared_bytes=result["shared_bytes"] - control["shared_bytes"],
                )
                summary["decisions"].append(decision)
                print("Decision:", decision, flush=True)
        summary["status"] = (
            "compile_feasible_pending_accuracy"
            if any(d["reason"] is None for d in summary["decisions"])
            else "not_promising"
        )
        print("No GPU execution. Score/TopK/pipeline timing: N/A.", flush=True)
        return 0
    except BaseException:
        summary.update(status="failed", error=traceback.format_exc())
        print(summary["error"], flush=True)
        return 1
    finally:
        trace.save(report / "producer-first-summary.json", summary)
        with tarfile.open(report / "producer-artifacts.tar.gz", "w:gz") as archive:
            for folder in sorted(report.iterdir()):
                if folder.is_dir() and folder.name.startswith("perf_"):
                    for path in sorted(folder.iterdir()):
                        if path.is_file():
                            archive.add(
                                path,
                                arcname=str(path.relative_to(report)),
                                recursive=False,
                            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Copyright 2026 FlagOS Contributors
"""Check cluster-only mutation and exact-tail resume before remote compilation."""

import ast
import json
import tempfile
import types
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from tools import qsa_prefill_producer_first as probe

IR = """#loc = loc("score.py":1:0)
module {
  %buf = ttg.local_alloc : () -> !ttg.memdesc<2x64x128xbf16, #shared>
  %v = scf.for %i = %first to %last step %one {
    %k = tt.load %p {loop.cluster = 1 : i32, loop.stage = 0 : i32} : tensor<64x128x!tt.ptr<bf16>, #blocked>
    %s = ttng.warp_group_dot %k, %q {loop.cluster = 0 : i32, loop.stage = 1 : i32}
    tt.store %o, %s {loop.cluster = 0 : i32, loop.stage = 1 : i32}
    scf.yield
  }
}
"""
SOURCE = """class CUDABackend:
    @staticmethod
    def make_ttgir(mod, metadata, opt, capability):
        forbidden_prefix()
        if capability // 10 in [8, 9]:
            forbidden_schedule()
            passes.ttgpuir.add_pipeline(pm, opt.num_stages, dump_enabled)
        elif capability // 10 >= 10:
            forbidden_other_arch()
        passes.common.tail(pm)
        pm.run(mod, 'make_ttgir')
        metadata['cluster_dims'] = tuple(opt.cluster_dims)
        return mod
"""


def final_ir(early, slots=2):
    copy = "    %k = ttg.async_copy_global_to_local %p, %buf : tensor<64x128x!tt.ptr<bf16>, #blocked>"
    dot = "    %v = ttng.warp_group_dot %buf, %q"
    body = [copy, dot] if early else [dot, copy]
    return "\n".join(
        [
            "module {",
            f"  %buf = ttg.local_alloc : () -> !ttg.memdesc<{slots}x64x128xbf16, #shared>",
            "  %result = scf.for %i = %a to %b step %one {",
            *body,
            "    %r = ttng.warp_group_dot_wait %v {pendings = 0 : i32}",
            "    tt.store %o, %r",
            "    scf.yield",
            "  }",
            "}",
        ]
    )


PTX = "wgmma.mma_async.sync.aligned x; cp.async.cg.shared.global [%r1], [%rd1], 0x10;"


class ProducerFirstTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_snapshot_is_complete_and_unique(self):
        text = (
            "// -----// IR Dump Before OtherPass\nwrong\n"
            "// -----// IR Dump Before TritonGPUPipeline (tritongpu-pipeline)\n"
            + IR
            + "// -----// IR Dump Before NextPass\nwrong"
        )
        self.assertEqual(probe.snapshot(text), IR)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "exactly one"):
            probe.snapshot(text + text)
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            probe.snapshot(IR)

    def test_only_cluster_digits_change_and_rewrite_is_involution(self):
        changed, count = probe.producer_first(IR)
        self.assertEqual(count, 3)
        self.assertEqual(probe.producer_first(changed)[0], IR)
        strip = lambda text: text.replace(
            "loop.cluster = 0", "loop.cluster = X"
        ).replace("loop.cluster = 1", "loop.cluster = X")
        self.assertEqual(strip(IR), strip(changed))
        self.assertIn("loop.cluster = 0 : i32, loop.stage = 0 : i32", changed)
        for bad in (
            IR.replace("loop.stage = 1", "loop.stage = 2"),
            IR.replace("loop.cluster = 1", "loop.cluster = 2"),
            IR + IR,
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                probe.producer_first(bad)

    def test_resume_executes_pipeline_and_exact_tail_but_no_prefix(self):
        calls = []

        class PM:
            def enable_debug(self):
                calls.append("debug")
                return True

            def run(self, mod, tag):
                calls.append(tag)

        pm = PM()
        scope = dict(
            ir=types.SimpleNamespace(pass_manager=lambda context: pm),
            passes=types.SimpleNamespace(
                ttgpuir=types.SimpleNamespace(
                    add_pipeline=lambda p, n, d: calls.append(("pipeline", n, d))
                ),
                common=types.SimpleNamespace(tail=lambda p: calls.append("tail")),
            ),
        )
        fn, generated = probe.resume_function(SOURCE, scope)
        obj = types.SimpleNamespace(context=None)
        metadata = {}
        self.assertIs(
            fn(
                obj,
                metadata,
                types.SimpleNamespace(num_stages=2, cluster_dims=(1, 1, 1)),
                90,
            ),
            obj,
        )
        self.assertEqual(calls, ["debug", ("pipeline", 2, True), "tail", "make_ttgir"])
        old = ast.parse(SOURCE).body[0].body[0]
        new = ast.parse(generated).body[0]
        self.assertEqual(
            [ast.dump(n) for n in old.body[2:]], [ast.dump(n) for n in new.body[3:]]
        )
        self.assertEqual(metadata, dict(cluster_dims=(1, 1, 1)))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "Unsupported"):
            probe.resume_function(SOURCE.replace("[8, 9]", "[9]"), scope)

    def test_schedule_typed_copy_buffer_growth_and_work_gate(self):
        a = dict(
            schedule=probe.inspect(final_ir(False), PTX),
            spill_store_bytes=0,
            spill_load_bytes=0,
        )
        b = dict(a, schedule=probe.inspect(final_ir(True, 3), PTX))
        self.assertEqual(a["schedule"]["early_K_copies"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(b["schedule"]["early_K_copies"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(b["schedule"]["K_slots"], 3)
        self.assertIsNone(probe.gate(a, b))
        self.assertIn("no early", probe.gate(a, a))
        self.assertIn("spills", probe.gate(a, dict(b, spill_load_bytes=16)))
        self.assertIn(
            "matrix", probe.gate(a, dict(b, schedule=dict(b["schedule"], mma_sites=2)))
        )
        self.assertIn(
            "buffer", probe.gate(a, dict(b, schedule=dict(b["schedule"], K_slots=4)))
        )
        self.assertIn(
            "wait", probe.gate(a, dict(b, schedule=dict(b["schedule"], waits=[])))
        )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "Unidentified"):
            probe.inspect(
                final_ir(True).replace("ttg.async_copy_global_to_local", "tt.load"), PTX
            )

    def test_resources_never_treat_unknown_spills_as_zero(self):
        text = (
            "ptxas info : Used 63 registers\n"
            "ptxas info : 0 bytes stack frame, 0 bytes spill stores, 0 bytes spill loads"
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            probe.resources(text),
            dict(registers_per_thread=63, spill_store_bytes=0, spill_load_bytes=0),
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            probe.resources(
                text.replace("0 bytes spill stores", "32 bytes spill stores")
            )["spill_store_bytes"],
            32,
        )
        for bad in ("", "Used 63 registers", text + "\nUsed 64 registers"):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "Unknown/ambiguous"):
                probe.resources(bad)

    def test_prepare_preserves_captured_files_and_original_options(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            source = root / "old"
            report = root / "new"
            source.mkdir()
            report.mkdir()
            jobs = []
            for case in probe.trace.CASES:
                folder = source / (case + "-baseline")
                folder.mkdir()
                ptx = folder / "replayed-ptx.txt"
                ptx.write_text("original PTX")
                metadata = folder / "cached.json"
                metadata.write_text('{"num_stages":2}')
                spec = dict(
                    expected_ptx_sha256=probe.trace.sha(ptx),
                    metadata=str(metadata),
                    metadata_sha256=probe.trace.sha(metadata),
                    original_resources=dict(constants=dict(num_stages=2)),
                )
                probe.trace.save(folder / "spec.json", spec)
                (folder / "passes.txt").write_text(
                    "// IR Dump Before TritonGPUPipeline (tritongpu-pipeline)\n" + IR
                )
                jobs.append(
                    dict(
                        name=folder.name,
                        exit_code=0,
                        coverage=dict(all=True),
                        result=dict(
                            status="passed",
                            actual_ptx_sha256=probe.trace.sha(ptx),
                            expected_ptx_sha256=probe.trace.sha(ptx),
                        ),
                    )
                )
            probe.trace.save(
                source / "pipeline-trace-summary.json",
                dict(
                    status="passed",
                    gpu_kernel_executed=False,
                    jobs=jobs
                    + [
                        dict(j, name=j["name"].replace("-baseline", "-candidate"))
                        for j in jobs
                    ],
                ),
            )
            before = {str(p): p.read_bytes() for p in source.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
            created = probe.prepare(source, report)
            self.assertEqual(len(created), 4)
            self.assertEqual(
                before,
                {str(p): p.read_bytes() for p in source.rglob("*") if p.is_file()},
            )
            self.assertEqual([x["cluster_changes"] for x in created], [0, 3, 0, 3])
            self.assertTrue(
                all(
                    json.loads(Path(x["metadata"]).read_text())["num_stages"] == 2
                    for x in created
                )
            )

    def test_no_GPU_execution_or_installed_source_edits(self):
        tree = ast.parse(Path(probe.__file__).read_text())
        calls = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Call)]
        call = next(n for n in calls if ast.unparse(n.func) == "triton.compile")
        self.assertEqual({k.arg for k in call.keywords}, {"target", "options"})
        self.assertFalse(
            any(
                isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute)
                and n.func.attr in {"warmup", "_init_handles", "empty", "synchronize"}
                for n in calls
            )
        )
        self.assertFalse(
            any(
                isinstance(n, ast.Attribute) and n.attr in {"n_regs", "n_spills"}
                for n in ast.walk(tree)
            )
        )
        self.assertIn('CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""', Path(probe.__file__).read_text())
        runner = (probe.ROOT / "tools/run_qsa_prefill_producer_first.sh").read_text()
        self.assertIn('"$qsa_report"/*.tar.gz', runner)
        self.assertIn('exit "$qsa_status"', runner)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

# Run via bash, never source into the interactive container shell.
set -euo pipefail
qsa_repo=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)
qsa_python=${QSA_STOCK_PYTHON:-${PYTHON:-python}}
qsa_report=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/qsa-producer-first-h800.XXXXXX")
echo "运行目录：$qsa_repo"
echo "报告目录：$qsa_report"
echo "Python：$qsa_python"
git -C "$qsa_repo" rev-parse HEAD
git -C "$qsa_repo" status --short
unset PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME QSA_TRITON_RUNTIME_PATH QSA_NATIVE_REFERENCE_PYTHON QSA_NATIVE_REPORT_DIR QSA_NATIVE_RESULT_PATH CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING
export PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 DNN_VENDOR=nvidia VLLM_PLUGINS=""
qsa_kind=producer-first
qsa_status=0
if "$qsa_python" -I "$qsa_repo/tools/qsa_prefill_producer_first.py" \
  --report-dir "$qsa_report" "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$qsa_report/runner.txt"
then
  echo "Producer-first compile probe 完成，开始回传。"
else
  qsa_status=$?
  echo "测试退出码：$qsa_status；回传已有报告。"
fi
printf 'probe_exit_code=%s\n' "$qsa_status" > "$qsa_report/run-status.txt"
cp -- "$qsa_report/runner.txt" "$qsa_report/terminal-summary.txt"
qsa_stamp=$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
qsa_branch="codex/qsa-h800-results-$qsa_stamp"
qsa_tree=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/flaggems-qsa-probe-results.XXXXXX")
git -C "$qsa_repo" worktree add -b "$qsa_branch" "$qsa_tree" HEAD
qsa_dest="results/qsa_select_paged_prefill/h800/$qsa_kind-$qsa_stamp"
mkdir -p "$qsa_tree/$qsa_dest"
shopt -s nullglob
qsa_files=("$qsa_report"/*.json "$qsa_report"/*.txt "$qsa_report"/*.tsv "$qsa_report"/*.csv "$qsa_report"/*.tar.gz)
cp -- "${qsa_files[@]}" "$qsa_tree/$qsa_dest/"
git -C "$qsa_tree" add -- "$qsa_dest"
qsa_name=$(git -C "$qsa_repo" config user.name || printf '%s' 'cheersluvs')
qsa_email=$(git -C "$qsa_repo" config user.email || printf '%s' 'yuqingwu51@gmail.com')
git -C "$qsa_tree" -c user.name="$qsa_name" -c user.email="$qsa_email" commit -m "Report QSA producer-first schedule feasibility"
if git -C "$qsa_tree" push https://github.com/cheersluvs/FlagGems-vllm.git "HEAD:refs/heads/$qsa_branch"
then
  echo "报告回传完成。"
else
  echo "回传失败；无需重测。报告目录：$qsa_report"
  echo "重试：git -C '$qsa_tree' push https://github.com/cheersluvs/FlagGems-vllm.git 'HEAD:refs/heads/$qsa_branch'"
  exit 1
fi
echo "结果分支：$qsa_branch"
git -C "$qsa_tree" rev-parse HEAD
echo "测试退出码：$qsa_status"
exit "$qsa_status"

# Producer-first schedule feasibility probe

## Pre-code project board (2026-10-26)

|Field|Frozen choice|
|---|---|
|Task/evidence|QSA score only; validated pass trace2dea5593, four exact original PTX/TTGIR replays; coarse consumer-first clustering leaves next-K copy behind dot/store|
|Editable|This board, private compile-only driver, CPU tests, upload runner|
|Read-only|Production0d7e80e2, configs, references, all prior probes, captured trace and installed compiler files|
|One hypothesis|Reverse cluster0/1 for the original two-stage production schedule, preserving stage numbers and all operations/operands; test whether next-K async copying moves before current dot|
|Active set|First captured BF16 R32 and R64 production chunk; each gets unmodified-input control and producer-first candidate|
|Build|CPU tests, CLI help, bash syntax, changed-file pre-commit; remote four CPU compilations through the pinned FlagTree library|
|Validation|Unmodified control must reproduce captured PTX exactly; MLIR verifier and full original compiler tail run; preserve WGMMA work/waits; inspect K copy placement, buffers, resources and spills|
|Benchmark|None yet. No tensor creation, GPU binary loading, kernel launch or timer; score/TopK/pipeline performance remains unmeasured|
|Gate|Zero/known spill bytes, unchanged MMA count, identifiable loop and hardware async copy; real K copy before first dot required; extra K buffers reported explicitly, not called free|
|Timeout|300s per child; own process-group termination on timeout; upload partial evidence|
|Autotune|Exempt diagnostic: original captured launch options only, no search or production config change|
|Profiler|Pass dumps, PTXAS verbose resource log and final TTGIR/PTX; no new hardware counters|
|Scope|NVIDIA compiler diagnostic adapter; not yet a portable production implementation. A successful schedule must later be expressed/ported and numerically validated|

## Contract board

|Field|Preserved|
|---|---|
|API/math/dtype/layout|All original captured operations, pointer arithmetic, masks, reductions, stores, signatures and constants remain identical; only two cluster IDs exchange|
|Memory/synchronization|Original compiler decides buffer count, async waits, fences and barriers; do not delete waits or edit generated PTX|
|Inputs|No tensor inputs or Torch compute; scalar metadata and captured intermediate IR only|
|Production paths|All public/general/compact/FP8/TopK paths unchanged and unexecuted|
|Coverage limit|Compile verification is not a proof of runtime correctness; no speedup claim or production integration|

## Implementation paths board

|Path|Action/limit|
|---|---|
|Prepare|Require successful four-way prior trace with exact PTX hashes; read original baseline pre-TritonGPUPipeline snapshot; confirm clusters/stages are exactly0/1; make control/candidate copies|
|Adapter|Hash-check original compiler.py; derive its exact AST tail starting with the existing SM90 pipeline call; retain every subsequent pass and metadata action; skip already executed prefix|
|Resume|Use a private process-local static-method replacement and explicit SM90 target; feed captured pre-pipeline IR into the unchanged pipeline and tail; no installed-file edits|
|Control|Exact original PTX equality is mandatory before interpreting the altered schedule|
|Candidate|Change only loop.cluster IDs0↔1; do not change stage numbers or insert/remove/move source operations manually|
|Resources|Enable TRITON_DUMP_PTXAS_LOG only (assembler already invokes -v); parse actual register/spill bytes and metadata shared size; never infer unknown spills as zero|
|Result|compile_feasible_pending_accuracy, not_promising or failure; report buffer growth and retain all artifacts; no automatic execution even on feasibility|
|Delivery|Terminal placement/resource results plus JSON/TXT and compressed pass artifacts; automatic upload in child bash|

The captured compiler hashes fix the Python adapter's input. C++ source suggests
producer-first ordering can increase stageDiff and add a K buffer; the actual
compiled buffer allocation is decisive. Do not clamp that allocation or remove
its synchronization merely to meet a resource budget.

Unmodified control equality checks the resumed compiler tail, including layout,
allocation, fences and target lowering. The experiment does not patch C++ code,
force CUDA policy hints or add backend instructions to the operator.

## Local validation

Seven new CPU tests plus nine existing replay tests pass. Captured production
snapshots from report2dea5593 prepare all four jobs without original-file edits:
R32 exchanges60 cluster attributes and R64 exchanges64; applying the same
exchange twice restores the original text exactly. Stage IDs, operations and
all other text are unchanged. The adapter calibrated against the pinned real
compiler.py preserves all27 top-level tail statements exactly in AST form.
CLI help, bash syntax and applicable pre-commit checks pass.

The remote resumed control compilation and candidate compilation have not run
locally. This is a feasibility experiment with runtime correctness and all
score/TopK/pipeline timing deliberately pending.
